# Competitive Edge

> Peak sports performance coaching and mental toughness training for athletes, coaches, and parents led by Dr. Alan Goldberg and Sara Vatore.

Competitive Edge specializes in helping athletes overcome performance anxiety, sports fears, and mental blocks through personalized coaching, workshops, and evidence-based methods like the MELT Method. The practice combines sports psychology expertise with somatic experiencing techniques to build mental toughness and peak performance capabilities.
